title: Orange Beef
description: A takeout-style orange beef dish with crispy steak pieces coated in a bold sweet, tangy, orange-flavored sauce.

ingredients.name: rib-eye steak
ingredients.quantity: 1 boneless steak (1 to 1 1/2 pounds), cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.quantity: 6, white and green parts separated, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.instruction: Make the sauce by heating 1 tablespoon of neutral oil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger, jalapeño, and orange zest, then sauté until softened, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 more minutes until softened.
Stir in the orange juice, brown sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and fish sauce.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the sauce thickens and reduces by half, about 10 to 15 minutes.
Prepare the beef by combining the egg white, cornstarch, and salt in a bowl.
Add the steak pieces and toss until evenly coated.
Heat 1/4 cup neutral oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add the beef in a single layer and cook without stirring for 60 to 90 seconds until crisp and golden underneath.
Add the white scallion pieces and dried red chiles, then flip the beef and cook for about 3 more minutes until medium-rare.
Transfer the beef to a platter.
Pour the orange sauce into the hot skillet or wok and boil, stirring as it thickens.
Return the beef to the pan and toss until coated in the sauce.
Transfer to a serving platter, top with green scallions, and serve.
